name: OneNote
label: Microsoft Graph OneNote
description: Microsoft Graph OneNote via OfficialApiNode (nodes/onenote/api_spec.json). Official Graph OneNote. Notes.ReadWrite. page_create body is HTML (presentation). file_download returns page content as file ref when the handler stores the body. Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/onenote?view=graph-rest-1.0. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One OneNote official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"notebook_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'notebook_create', 'notebook_get', 'section_create', 'section_get', 'page_create', 'page_get', 'page_copy', 'page_delete', 'page_content', 'file_download', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'notebook_create'.

schema.label: displayName
schema.description: Notebook or section display name for notebook_create / section_create. Example: Project notes.

schema.label: notebook_id
schema.description: OneNote notebook id for notebook_get and section_create.

schema.label: section_id
schema.description: OneNote section id for section_get and page_create.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Page title belongs in the html document's <title> (Graph create-page is text/html, not JSON). Not sent as a sibling field. Example: A page with rendered HTML.

schema.label: html
schema.description:
page_create raw body: well-formed XHTML/HTML sent as Content-Type text/html to POST /me/onenote/sections/{section_id}/pages. Include in the document. Example: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Notes

Hi

. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/section-post-pages

schema.label: page_id
schema.description: OneNote page id for page_get / page_copy / page_delete / page_content / file_download.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Destination section id for page_copy (copyToSection body id).

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: notebook_create, notebook_get, section_create, section_get, page_create, page_get, page_copy, page_delete, page_content, file_download, listen. Default: notebook_create. Example: notebook_create.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Graph Client State
configurationParameters.description: Microsoft Graph subscription clientState verified against inbound value[*].clientState. Never logged.
